trends.what: A curated list of free public APIs for developers to use in their projects.
trends.why: It's a one-stop reference for developers seeking free data sources, making it a perennial favorite for rapid prototyping and learning.

trends.what: An open-source platform offering free coding lessons, projects, and certifications in web development, data science, and more.
trends.why: It democratizes tech education with a massive, self-paced curriculum, making it a go-to for career changers and self-taught developers.

trends.what: A massive collection of freely accessible programming books, tutorials, and learning resources in multiple languages.
trends.why: It's the ultimate free library for coders, saving learners hundreds of dollars while covering every conceivable tech topic.

trends.what: A personal AI assistant that runs on any OS and platform, designed to be your always-available digital helper.
trends.why: It taps into the booming demand for local, private AI assistants that don't rely on cloud services, giving users full control.

trends.what: Interactive roadmaps and guides that chart out learning paths for various developer roles and technologies.
trends.why: It helps overwhelmed beginners and career-switchers visualize exactly what to learn next, reducing decision paralysis in tech.

trends.what: A tool that makes AI agents write code with the minimal-effort, pragmatic mindset of a lazy senior developer.
trends.why: It's a humorous yet practical take on AI code quality, pushing for simpler, less bloated outputs that are easier to maintain.

trends.what: A fullscreen, mouse-interactive terminal UI and harness for running coding agents, designed for extensibility.
trends.why: It brings a polished, IDE-like experience to terminal-based AI coding, appealing to power users who want more control.

trends.what: A pure C, zero-dependency runtime that runs large mixture-of-experts AI models on consumer hardware by streaming experts from disk.
trends.why: It makes frontier AI models accessible on ordinary PCs, breaking the assumption that you need expensive GPUs for serious AI.
